incarnation: Currently selected Killa Mayu V2 original-project portrait, 2026
sourceLimits: The personally viewed selected V2 original-project portrait is internal authority, not external historical proof. No absolute 1:1 certification.
Visible face, textile, sling and khipu surfaces qualified; concealed back anatomy and tiny knots remain unknown.
No numerical age or sex asserted from the image. Family-safe and non-romantic throughout; CG13 alone explicitly swaps gender presentation.
New settings are original compatible Andean high-road compositions; no claim to historical religious reconstruction.
Personally viewed old atlas is historical, visibly different: crescent crown, white dress, feminine face, no sling/khipu; it is not source authority.
